capital.$comment: Decimal or null: a component that is not ready at the cutoff is null and carries its status in capital_status; it is never a stand-in value.

label.const: Governed PORT-HWM-4 candidate, pending owner acceptance

performance.$comment: JSON Schema uniqueItems cannot enforce semantic account-strategy identity for generic objects; the Python panel validator owns that invariant.

strategies.$comment: JSON Schema uniqueItems cannot enforce semantic strategy identity for generic objects; the Python panel validator owns that invariant.

portfolio_twr_cumulative.$comment: PANEL-VIS-002: headline portfolio return is the governed HWM index series (base 100); the summed-epoch TWR and the difference are published beside it.

portfolio_mwr_annualised.$comment: PANEL-VIS-002: one XIRR over governed external flows; value is null (with the window-equivalent cumulative) when the window is under 365 days.

capital_reconciliation.$comment: PANEL-VIS-002: derived total net capital minus governed invested capital, split into named components that sum to the difference with a zero residual.

performance_tab.$comment: Additive producer block for the Performance tab (own schema_version, no panel version bump).
